speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I hear you have fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes; please tell me your age and how long these symptoms have been present. To start our workup, please describe the texture and size of the lymph node you are feeling.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma

Dr. Agent, I have noted your four-week history of worsening symptoms, significant weight loss, and night sweats. Before we proceed to imaging, could you confirm if you have noticed any pain specifically in your lymph nodes shortly after they swell? Additionally, do you have any known history of autoimmune diseases or previous cancer?
